crossRefs.note: If I take the wings of the dawn, and settle in the uttermost parts of the sea,
Can his armies be counted? On whom does his light not arise?
The sun also rises, and the sun goes down, and hurries to its place where it rises.
if it is so that you continue in the faith, grounded and steadfast, and not moved away from the hope of the Good News…
Thick clouds are a covering to him, so that he doesn’t see. He walks on the vault of the sky.’

translations.web: His going out is from the end of the heavens, his circuit to its ends. There is nothing hidden from its heat.
translations.bsb: it rises at one end of the heavens and runs its circuit to the other; nothing is deprived of its warmth.
translations.kjv: His going forth is from the end of the heaven, and his circuit unto the ends of it: and there is nothing hid from the heat
translations.asv: His going forth is from the end of the heavens, And his circuit unto the ends of it; And there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.
